subject: PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI FOR THURSDAY, JULY 2, 2026
plaintextBody:
City Seal 170

July 1, 2026 

*FOR PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY*  

*CONTACT:* pressoffice@cityhall.nyc.gov   

  

*PUBLIC SCHEDULE FOR MAYOR ZOHRAN KWAME MAMDANI*  

*FOR THURSDAY, JULY 2, 2026* 

 

"On Thursday, Mayor Mamdani will visit older adults at a cooling center. Footage from this event will be pooled by CBS2 and distributed after the stop." 

 

"Following the event, the Mayor will host a roundtable with Muslim community leaders. This event is closed to press." 

 

"Then, the Mayor will join New York City Police Department (NYPD) Commissioner Jessica S. Tisch for a quarterly crime statistics briefing. The event will be ""streamed live" [ https://x.com/NYPDnews?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]" and available on ""YouTube.com/NYPD" [ https://www.youtube.com/NYPD?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Facebook.com/NYPD" [ https://www.facebook.com/NYPD?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", and ""X.com/NYPDNews" [ https://x.com/NYPDnews?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]". ""NYC credentialed members of the media should arrive and be in place no later than 12:30 PM." 

 

"After, the Mayor will provide updates on extreme heat response and safety live on WCBS-FM (101.1 FM)." 

 

"Later, the Mayor will provide updates on extreme heat response and safety live on WBLS (107.5 FM)." 

 

_*Press Schedule*_:" "  

 

*8:30 AM – Visits Older Adults at Cooling Center* 

"Footage from this event will be pooled by CBS2 and distributed after the stop." 

 

*10:00 AM – Hosts Roundtable with Muslim Community Leaders* 

"This event is closed to press." 

 

*1:00 PM – Joins NYPD Commissioner Jessica S. Tisch for a Quarterly Crime Statistics Briefing* 

"One Police Plaza, 2nd Floor Press Room, New York, NY 10038." 

"The event will be ""streamed live" [ https://x.com/NYPDnews?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]" and available on ""YouTube.com/NYPD" [ https://www.youtube.com/NYPD?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", ""Facebook.com/NYPD" [ https://www.facebook.com/NYPD?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]", and ""X.com/NYPDNews" [ https://x.com/NYPDnews?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ]"."  

"NYC credentialed members of the media should arrive and be in place no later than 12:30 PM." 

 

*1:55 PM (Approx.) – Provides Updates on Extreme Heat Response and Safety Live on WCBS-FM (101.1 FM)* 

 

*2:00 PM (Approx.) – Provides Updates on Extreme Heat Response and Safety Live on WBLS (107.5 FM)* 

 

Photos will be available here [ https://www.flickr.com/photos/nycmayorsoffice/?utm_medium=email&utm_name=&utm_source=govdelivery ].
